mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mock_user (profile_code, login_id, login_password_hash, connection_id, org_code, org_name) VALUES (#{profileCode}, #{loginId}, #{loginPasswordHash}, #{connectionId}, #{orgCode}, #{orgName})
mapper.select: SELECT profile_code, login_id, login_password_hash, connection_id, org_code, org_name, scenario_json FROM mock_user WHERE login_id = #{loginId}
SELECT profile_code, login_id, login_password_hash, connection_id, org_code, org_name, scenario_json FROM mock_user WHERE profile_code = #{profileCode}
mapper.update: UPDATE mock_user SET org_code = #{orgCode}, org_name = #{orgName}, scenario_json = #{scenarioJson} WHERE profile_code = #{profileCode}
